title: A $12 Million Deal Right After High School
description:
She signed a 12 million dollar deal right after high school.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Serena Williams: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Serena_Williams

From Wikipedia (Serena Williams): coached by her parents, she turned professional in 1995 and won her first major at the 1999 US Open; after graduating from Driftwood Academy in 1999 she signed a $12 million endorsement deal with Puma; in 2004 a five-year, $40 million deal with Nike, whose largest building on its Portland campus is now the one-million-square-foot Serena Williams Building; 23 major singles titles, the most in the Open Era; the highest-earning woman athlete of all time. Not financial advice.

loop: So next time you finish a school year, remember:
cta: Serena or Venus? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: She signed a 12 million dollar deal right after high school.
Her coaches? Just her mom and dad.
Then a 40 million dollar shoe deal in 2004.
Then 23 major titles. The most of the Open Era.
Now her sponsor's biggest building? It's named after her.
